adjudication.rationale: The diff does remove the previous “create/update with usernames” bulk-membership path: `Admin::GroupsController#create` no longer reads `params[:group][:usernames]` (it now only sets `name`/`visible`), and `#update` no longer accepts `usernames` (membership is moved to new `add_members`/`remove_member` endpoints). On the client, `group.hbs` wraps the members UI in `{{#if id}}`, so you can’t add members until after the group is created/saved. The old spec that created a group with users in one step was also removed rather than adapted. This is a concrete, diff-grounded functional regression/change in workflow/feature surface, but it’s not provably a correctness bug since the new flow (create then add members) is supported via `addMembers`.
